envelopes.name: State Administration
envelopes.body: The civil service, revenue offices, records and ordinary machinery of the state.

envelopes.name: Foreign Affairs
envelopes.body: The diplomatic service, embassies, treaty administration and foreign intelligence work.

envelopes.name: Justice and Policing
envelopes.body: The courts, prosecutors, police and the institutions that make state authority lawful.

envelopes.name: National Defense
envelopes.body: The armed forces, border defense, readiness and procurement.

envelopes.name: Infrastructure
envelopes.body: Roads, rail, water, power networks and the capital works that bind the country together.

envelopes.name: Industry and Jobs
envelopes.body: Industrial support, employment programmes, rural credit and economic reconstruction.

envelopes.name: Education
envelopes.body: Schools, colleges, vocational training and the next generation of the workforce.

envelopes.name: Health and Welfare
envelopes.body: Hospitals, clinics, pensions, income support and protection from destitution.
